caption: The drawing depicts two adjacent sections of ornate wrought iron fencing, rendered in black and gray pencil on a beige background. Both sections are vertically oriented rectangles filled with intricate, repeating scrollwork patterns featuring symmetrical, curling vine and leaf motifs. Each section is bordered by straight vertical and horizontal bars, with the top of the fence adorned with a row of regularly spaced, pointed finials formed by floral shapes. The left section appears to be a gate with a visible hinge or post along the right side and a small horizontal bar at the base, featuring a denser decorative panel at the bottom that includes more scrollwork and a rosette design. The right section shows a similar decorative pattern but rests atop a stone base illustrated with light shading and blocks, with no visible hinge. The overall coloring consists of fine monochrome pencil lines and shading, giving a clear, detailed representation of the metalwork against the plain background.
title: Iron Gate
